dependencies.basis: Producer Price Index weights for domestic manufacturers draw on Industrial Production Statistics (alongside National Accounts and association data).
dependencies.evidence_quote: For manufacturer, in 2024, Industrial Production Statistics, National Accounts Statistics and data provided by relative associations are referred for weighting.

dependencies.basis: PPI weights incorporate National Accounts Statistics; PPI itself is used as a reference for GDP and Input-Output Tables.
dependencies.evidence_quote: For manufacturer, in 2024, Industrial Production Statistics, National Accounts Statistics and data provided by relative associations are referred for weighting. ... ② As a reference for GDP and I/O Tables.

dependencies.basis: National accounts production-side estimates and industry breakdowns draw on industrial production statistics as a primary short-term and structural input.
dependencies.evidence_quote: National Accounts statistics is compiled according to SNA, measured by supply(production), demand(expenditure) , and income approach to ensure data accuracy and reliability. ... National accounts statistics is compiled according to 2008SNA and the Statistical Classification of Industries (Rev.11).

dependencies.basis: CBC monetary statistics sectoral classification of financial-institution transactions conforms to the United Nations System of National Accounts.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The current methodology conforms to the United Nations “System of National Accounts,” and classifies the transactions of financial institutions into six sectors according to whether the counter party is a foreign entity, the government, a government enterprise, a private enterprise, an individual (household) or a domestic financial institution.

dependencies.basis: Household Final Consumption Expenditure component of National Accounts (used for CPI weights and other series) is derived in part from the Family Income and Expenditure Survey.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The major structure of weights is based on the Household Final Consumption Expenditure of National Income and is updated annually. ... which derives from the Family Income/Expenditure Survey.

dependencies.basis: Industrial Production Index classification follows the Statistical Classification of Industries of the R.O.C. (aligned with ISIC).
dependencies.evidence_quote: 產品之歸類：根據經濟部統計處編印之工業產品分類共1,595項，將性質相同產品整併為723項產品群。
